title: I used Claude to build a Poolrooms scene with Three.js + WebGPU
author: PerceptionCharming
selftext:
I've been experimenting with Claude for 3D projects, and I decided to build a liminal space scene inspired by the Poolrooms.

Claude helped me build the scene, and then I manually tweaked the lighting, reflections, camera movement, fisheye effect, and chromatic aberration to get the atmosphere I wanted. Those details really help create that strange feeling of being somewhere familiar, but also feeling like something is off.

It's built with Three.js and WebGPU, and runs entirely in the browser.

Try it here: [https://bkhan23544.github.io/poolrooms-threejs/](https://bkhan23544.github.io/poolrooms-threejs/)
